item.text: {"case_id":"SHC081","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C08","C19","C11"],"selected_candidate_label":"C08","confidence":0.94,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C08 plausibly supplied a concrete and material drafting template. Both proclamations impose new import restrictions by modifying subchapter III of chapter 99 of the HTS through an annex; exclude specified countries and products; delegate product-exclusion decisions to an executive official; require Federal Register publication before modifying the HTS to administer exclusions; use nearly identical entry-date, duration, and supersession clauses; and concern steel-sector import relief. C19 and C11 share much of the same safeguard-proclamation architecture and are temporally closer, but C08 supplies the especially material product-exclusion machinery and is the strongest displayed antecedent.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"In order to establish increases in the duty rate on imports of aluminum articles, subchapter III of chapter 99 of the HTSUS is modified as provided in the Annex to this proclamation.","parent_excerpt":"In order to establish increases in duty and a tariff rate quota on imports of the certain steel products described in paragraph 7 (other than excluded products), subchapter III of chapter 99 of the HTS is modified as provided in the Annex to this proclamation.","explanation":"Distinctive parallel operative mechanism: amend the same HTS subchapter through an annex to impose import relief on a metal product."},{"child_excerpt":"The Secretary ... is hereby authorized to provide relief from the additional duties ... for any aluminum article determined not to be produced in the United States in a sufficient and reasonably available amount or of a satisfactory quality ... If the Secretary determines that a particular aluminum article should be excluded, the Secretary shall, upon publishing a notice ... in the Federal Register ... [and] make such modification to the HTSUS through a notice in the Federal Register.","parent_excerpt":"The USTR is authorized to further consider any request for exclusion of a particular product ... and, upon publication in the Federal Register of a notice of his finding that a particular product should be excluded, to modify the HTS provisions created by the Annex to this proclamation to exclude such particular product from the pertinent safeguard measure.","explanation":"Substantially the same delegated product-exclusion machinery, including requests, an official determination, Federal Register notice, and modification of annex-created HTS provisions."},{"child_excerpt":"This rate of duty ... shall apply to imports of aluminum articles from all countries except Canada and Mexico.","parent_excerpt":"These safeguard measures shall apply to imports from all countries, except for products of Canada, Israel, Jordan, and Mexico.","explanation":"Parallel country-exclusion structure adapted to a different measure and product."},{"child_excerpt":"The modifications to the HTSUS made by the Annex ... shall be effective with respect to goods entered, or withdrawn from warehouse for consumption, on or after 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on March 23, 2018, and shall continue in effect, unless such actions are expressly reduced, modified, or terminated.","parent_excerpt":"The modifications to the HTS made by this proclamation, including the Annex hereto, shall be effective with respect to goods entered, or withdrawn from warehouse for consumption, on or after 12:01 a.m., EST, on March 20, 2002, and shall continue in effect as provided in the Annex to this proclamation, unless such actions are earlier expressly reduced, modified, or terminated.","explanation":"Near-verbatim effective-date and continuation formula tied to customs entry and possible later reduction, modification, or termination."},{"child_excerpt":"Any provision of previous proclamations and Executive Orders that is inconsistent with the actions taken in this proclamation is superseded to the extent of such inconsistency.","parent_excerpt":"Any provision of previous proclamations and Executive Orders that is inconsistent with the actions taken in this proclamation is superseded to the extent of such inconsistency.","explanation":"Exact shared language, reinforcing the broader operative-template match, though this clause alone is boilerplate."}]}
